abstract: We show that the emergence of new economic opportunities that draw women away from their traditional domestic roles has significantly influenced the adoption of religious veiling. We measure the prevalence of veiling among young women across Indonesia's districts for more than two decades by hand-coding around a quarter million photographs attached to Indonesia's public high school registers. To establish causality, we exploit exogenous variation generated by international demand for Indonesia's products, interacted with the gender and sectoral composition of local industries. Districts exposed to stronger positive economic shocks---and thus greater economic opportunities for women---exhibit higher rates of veiling adoption. Our findings suggest that veiling facilitates young women's participation in formal labor markets while safeguarding their personal and social image in society.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，吸引女性脱离传统家庭角色的新兴经济机会显著影响了宗教面纱的采用。我们通过手工编码印度尼西亚公立高中注册表上附带的约二十五万张照片，衡量了二十多年来印尼各地区年轻女性佩戴面纱的普遍程度。
title: Why Veil? Religious Headscarves and the Economic Role of Women
title_zh: 为何戴头巾？宗教头巾与女性的经济角色

abstract: We experimentally study decentralized one-to-one matching markets with transfers. We vary the information available to participants, complete or incomplete, and the surplus structure, supermodular or submodular. Several insights emerge. First, while markets often culminate in efficient matchings, stability is more elusive, reflecting the difficulty of arranging attendant transfers. Second, incomplete information and submodularity present hurdles to efficiency and especially stability; their combination drastically diminishes stability's likelihood. Third, matchings form ``from the top down'' in complete-information supermodular markets, but exhibit many more and less-obviously ordered offers otherwise. Last, participants' market positions matter far more than their dynamic bargaining styles for outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究具有转移支付的分散式一对一匹配市场。我们变化参与者可获得的信息，即完全或不完全信息，以及剩余结构，即超模或子模。由此得出若干洞见。
title: Paying to Match: Decentralized Markets with Information Frictions
title_zh: 付费匹配：信息摩擦下的分散市场

abstract: We study opinion dynamics in a social network consisting of two groups. Agents update their opinions by conforming to members of their own group while rejecting the views of the opposing group (affective polarization), and by listening to a media outlet that may provide biased information. We characterize the long-run opinions and identify when affective polarization and media bias lead to ideological polarization, persistent disagreement, or failures of learning. We also derive when information interventions or censorship improve the accuracy of average opinions} and reduce disagreement, and when they backfire: better information helps only under specific media bias configurations and when directed to the agents we identify as most effective at propagating it through the network.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个由两个群体组成的社会网络中的观点动态。个体通过遵循本群体成员的意见并排斥对立群体的观点（情感极化）来更新自己的看法，同时也会听取可能提供有偏信息的媒体渠道。
title: Affective Polarization, Media Outlets, and Opinion Dynamics
title_zh: 情感极化、媒体渠道与舆论动态

abstract: We examine how labor market competition affects the quality of workplace information on social media. Using employer reviews on Glassdoor for U.S. publicly listed firms from 2011 to 2022, we find that reviews become less informative about actual workplace practices when firms face more intense competition for labor, consistent with competition inducing workplace information management. The decline in review informativeness is more pronounced when employees have narrower external networks, when firms are less unionized, and when firms have a smaller review base, suggesting that workplace information management is more likely when labor market information asymmetry is greater. Additional analyses show that positive reviews in highly competitive labor markets predict higher short-term labor inflows but greater subsequent employee turnover, indicating a gap between managed expectations and actual workplace conditions. Taken together, our evidence suggests that labor market competition potentially distorts the crowdsourced signals available to job seekers on anonymous review websites.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了劳动力市场竞争如何影响社交媒体上职场信息的质量。利用2011年至2022年间美国上市公司在Glassdoor上的雇主评价，我们发现当企业面临更激烈的劳动力竞争时，评价对实际工作场所实践的反映程度降低，这与竞争诱发职场信息管理现象相符。评价信息量的下降在员工外部网络较窄、企业工会化程度较低以及企业评价基数较小的情况下更为显著，这表明当劳动力市场信息不对称程度更高时，职场信息管理更易发生。进一步分析显示，在高度竞争的劳动力市场中，正面评价能预测短期劳动力流入的增加，但随后员工离职率也更高，揭示了管理预期与实际工作条件之间的差距。综合来看，我们的证据表明，劳动力市场竞争可能扭曲了匿名评价网站上求职者可获得的众包信号。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: How labor market competition shapes workplace information on social media: evidence from Glassdoor reviews
title_zh: 劳动力市场竞争如何塑造社交媒体上的职场信息：来自Glassdoor点评的证据

abstract: Consumer experiences are inherently dynamic. When engaging in a sequence of activities, consumers are influenced by past experiences in two ways: negatively by their objective quality, through quality contrast; and positively by their subjective appreciation of them, through affect assimilation. How should experience curators sequence activities to maximize consumer satisfaction in the presence of such intertemporal effects? We formulate an experience curator’s problem as a dynamic optimization program. We show that, because of affect assimilation, the best activity may be scheduled at the beginning or in the middle of an experience, in contrast to the common peak-end rule—this provides a rationale for the saying that “first impressions matter.” Under uncertainty, it may be valuable to save the best activity as a “wild card” to recover from bad outcomes. We calibrate our model to four distinct experiential contexts (namely, watching movies, reading books, visiting touristic attractions, and eating out) and consistently find the presence of both quality contrast and affect assimilation. Through a counterfactual study in the context of touristic tours, we show that experience curators may significantly benefit from offering different fixed sequences to different types of consumers, but they tend to gain little from dynamically adjusting them. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, operations management. Funding: This work was supported by the Agencia Estatal de Investigación [Grant PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150 .
abstract_zh: 消费者体验本质上是动态的。在参与一系列活动时，消费者会以两种方式受到过往经历的影响：一方面，通过质量对比，客观质量产生负面影响；另一方面，通过情感同化，主观欣赏产生正面影响。在此类跨期效应存在的情况下，体验策划者应如何安排活动顺序以最大化消费者满意度？我们将体验策划者的问题构建为动态优化模型。研究表明，由于情感同化的作用，最佳活动可能被安排在体验的开始或中间阶段，这与常见的“峰终定律”相悖——这为“第一印象至关重要”的说法提供了理论依据。在不确定性条件下，保留最佳活动作为“王牌”以应对不良结果可能具有价值。我们将模型校准至四种不同的体验情境（即观影、阅读书籍、游览旅游景点及外出就餐），并一致发现质量对比与情感同化同时存在。通过旅游观光情境下的反事实研究，我们表明体验策划者通过向不同类型的消费者提供不同的固定序列可显著获益，但动态调整序列所带来的收益往往甚微。本文由David Simchi-Levi（运营管理领域）接受。资助：本研究受西班牙国家研究机构[基金号PID2020-116135GB-I00 MCIN/AEI/10.13039/50110001]支持。补充材料：在线附录及数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.02150获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: The Engineering of Consumer Experiences Under Affect Assimilation and Quality Contrast
title_zh: 情感同化与质量对比下的消费者体验工程

abstract: We return to the theoretical foundations of absorptive capacity and test the idea that personal experience in a field makes it easier for a firm’s inventors to recognize and build upon knowledge in that field from other local firms. We propose a new empirical model of localized knowledge diffusion, which (1) measures a firm’s absorptive capacity by its inventors’ prior experience in a field, (2) uses a death instrument to exogenously vary the availability of knowledge of the same collaborative patent in different regions, and (3) estimates the difference in citation likelihood from all subsequent inventors across both regions as a function of a potentially citing inventor’s prior experience in the field. Consistent with the original theory of absorptive capacity, firms whose inventors have prior experience in a field are more likely to use locally available interpersonal knowledge from other firms; furthermore, this effect declines monotonically with distance. Although the effects strengthen for more recent experience and multidisciplinary knowledge, the greatest benefits accrue to firms in the interaction—those whose inventors have more recent experience and that seek to absorb multidisciplinary knowledge. Interpersonal absorptive capacity within firms does not appear to localize. This paper was accepted by Anita McGahan, business strategy. Funding: The authors acknowledge financial support from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation and the National Science Foundation [Grant 1360228]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147 .
abstract_zh: 我们回归吸收能力的理论基础，检验一个观点：个人在某一领域的经验能帮助企业发明者更容易识别并利用该领域来自其他本地企业的知识。我们提出了一种新的本地化知识扩散实证模型，该模型（1）通过发明者在某一领域的先前经验来衡量企业的吸收能力，（2）利用死亡工具来外生地变化同一合作专利在不同地区知识的可用性，以及（3）估计所有后续发明者跨地区引用可能性的差异，作为潜在引用发明者在该领域先前经验的函数。与吸收能力的原始理论一致，发明者在某一领域有先前经验的企业更有可能利用来自其他企业的本地人际知识；此外，这种效应随距离增加而单调递减。虽然对于较近期的经验和跨学科知识，这种效应会增强，但最大的收益归于处于互动中的企业——即那些发明者拥有较新近经验且寻求吸收跨学科知识的企业。企业内部的人际吸收能力似乎并未表现出本地化特征。本文已被商业策略领域的Anita McGahan接受。资助：作者感谢阿尔弗雷德·P·斯隆基金会及国家科学基金会[资助号1360228]的财务支持。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.06147获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Microfoundations of Absorptive Capacity as Revealed by Inventor Deaths
title_zh: 发明人去世所揭示的吸收能力微观基础

abstract: Explainable artificial intelligence (AI) models have been proposed to mitigate overreliance and underreliance on AI, which reduce the effectiveness of human-AI collaborative tools. Yet, empirical evidence is mixed, and the impact of explainable AI on the cognitive effort and fatigue of a decision maker (DM) is often overlooked. This paper offers a theoretical perspective on these issues. We develop an analytical model that incorporates the defining features of human and machine intelligence, capturing the limited but flexible nature of human cognition with imperfect machine recommendations. Crucially, we represent how AI-based explanations influence the DM’s belief in the algorithm’s predictive quality. Our results indicate that explainable AI has varying effects depending on the level of explainability provided. Although low explainability levels have no impact on decision accuracy and reliance behavior, they lessen the cognitive burden on the DM. In contrast, higher explainability levels enhance accuracy by improving overreliance but at the expense of increased underreliance. Further, the relative impact of explainability is higher when the DM is more cognitively constrained, when the decision task is sufficiently complex, or when the stakes are lower. Importantly, higher explainability levels can escalate the DM’s cognitive burden (and hence, overall processing time and fatigue) precisely when explanations are most needed (i.e., when the DM is pressed for time to complete a complex task and doubts the machine’s quality). Our study clarifies how explainability affects decision outcomes and cognitive effort, informing the design of effective human-AI systems across decision environments. This paper was accepted by Jeannette Song, operations management. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450 .
abstract_zh: 可解释人工智能（AI）模型已被提出，以缓解对AI的过度依赖和依赖不足问题，这些问题削弱了人机协作工具的有效性。然而，实证证据不一，且可解释AI对决策者认知努力和疲劳的影响常被忽视。本文从理论视角探讨这些问题。我们构建了一个分析模型，融合了人类智能与机器智能的定义性特征，捕捉了人类认知的有限但灵活特性，并结合了不完美的机器建议。关键的是，我们刻画了基于AI的解释如何影响决策者对算法预测质量的信念。我们的结果表明，可解释AI的效果因提供的可解释性水平而异。尽管低可解释性水平对决策准确性和依赖行为无影响，但它们减轻了决策者的认知负担。相反，较高的可解释性水平通过改善过度依赖来提升准确性，但代价是增加了依赖不足。此外，当决策者认知受限更严重、决策任务足够复杂或风险较低时，可解释性的相对影响更大。重要的是，较高的可解释性水平恰恰在解释最被需要时（即决策者时间紧迫需完成复杂任务且怀疑机器质量时）可能加剧决策者的认知负担（从而增加整体处理时间和疲劳）。我们的研究阐明了可解释性如何影响决策结果和认知努力，为在不同决策环境中设计有效的人机系统提供了指导。本文被运营管理领域的Jeannette Song接受。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07450获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: Beyond the Black Box: Unraveling the Role of Explainability in Human-Artificial Intelligence Collaboration
title_zh: 超越黑箱：解析可解释性在人机协作中的作用

abstract: This paper examines the role played by the media in the shareholder proposal process. We find a positive relation between media coverage and the likelihood of being targeted by governance proposals. The effect is mostly observed for proposals submitted by non-institutional shareholders and driven by negative news. We further show that both “first reports” and repeated news contribute to increasing the probability of being targeted by governance proposals. This suggests that the media influence the shareholder proposal process both by conveying information to market participants and increasing firms' visibility. Negative media coverage is also associated with the success of proposals and changes in executive compensation and board turnover. Instrumental variable analysis and tests exploiting local newspaper closures suggest that the relationship between media coverage and shareholder proposals is causal. Our results shed light on a new channel through which the media can play a corporate governance role.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了媒体在股东提案过程中所扮演的角色。我们发现，媒体报道与成为治理提案目标的可能性之间存在正相关关系。这一效应主要体现在非机构股东提交的提案中，且由负面新闻驱动。我们进一步表明，“首次报道”和重复新闻均有助于提高成为治理提案目标的概率。这表明，媒体通过向市场参与者传递信息并提升企业可见度，从而影响股东提案过程。负面媒体报道还与提案的成功、高管薪酬变动及董事会更替相关联。工具变量分析及利用地方报纸停刊的检验表明，媒体报道与股东提案之间的关系具有因果性。我们的研究结果揭示了媒体发挥公司治理作用的新渠道。
title: The role of the media in corporate governance: evidence from shareholder proposals 1
title_zh: 媒体在公司治理中的作用：来自股东提案的证据

abstract: This paper examines the impact of net overseas migration (NOM) on residential property marketsusing annual, neighborhood-level data for Australia. We leverage an instrumental variableapproach based on historical immigrant settlement patterns to isolate plausibly exogenousvariation in migration flows. We find that a 1% increase in NOM, as a share of the local population,raises unit rents and prices by 5.0% and 1.3%, respectively, and increases house rents by3.6%. These effects are more pronounced in areas with low rates of dwelling approvals, suggestingthat housing supply constraints amplify the response of prices and rents to migration.In contrast, house prices decline by 1.3%, a pattern concentrated in older neighborhoods andconsistent with displacement dynamics, for which we present supporting evidence.
abstract_zh: 本文利用澳大利亚年度社区层面数据，考察了净海外移民（NOM）对住宅房地产市场的影响。我们采用基于历史移民定居模式的工具变量方法，以隔离移民流动中可能外生的变化。研究发现，NOM占当地人口比例每增加1%，单元房租金和价格分别上涨5.0%和1.3%，独栋房屋租金上涨3.6%。这些效应在住房审批率较低的地区更为显著，表明住房供应约束放大了价格和租金对移民的响应。相比之下，独栋房屋价格下降1.3%，这一模式集中在较老社区，与置换动态一致，我们为此提供了支持性证据。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Annual overseas migration and housing markets: Evidence from Australian neighborhoods
title_zh: 年度海外移民与住房市场：来自澳大利亚社区的证据

abstract: We study the extent of a one-size-fits-all approach in the design of public procurement (PP) tenders using comprehensive data from Finland. We show that crucial PP design features related to auction and contract rules tend to have significant lack of variation across different tenders for different industries within a contracting authority. We show that this organizational rigidness is due to both organizational level culture and individual employee level work habit formation with the latter being more important. We find that both greater organizational rigidity and deviating from the national industry norms are associated with lower number of bids and higher probability of zero-bid tenders, pointing to a potential efficiency loss from organizational rigidness in PP, and offering a solution that buyers could mimic how other organizations typically buy similar products rather than how they themselves buy very different products.
abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰的全面数据，研究了公共采购（PP）招标设计中“一刀切”方法的普遍程度。我们表明，与拍卖和合同规则相关的关键PP设计特征，在同一采购机构针对不同行业的不同招标中，往往缺乏显著变化。我们证明，这种组织僵化既源于组织层面的文化，也源于个体员工层面的工作习惯形成，其中后者更为重要。我们发现，更大的组织僵化以及偏离国家行业规范，均与投标数量减少和零投标招标概率增加相关，这暗示了公共采购中组织僵化可能导致的效率损失，并提出了一个解决方案：买家可以模仿其他组织通常如何采购类似产品，而非依据自身采购截然不同产品的习惯。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 250
title: Organizational culture and habit formation in public procurement
title_zh: 组织文化与公共采购中的习惯形成

abstract: This paper examines intergenerational mobility in China and Russia during their transitions from central planning to market systems. We consider mobility as movement, measured as changes in status between parents and children. We provide estimates of two key mobility measures: overall mobility, which captures total intergenerational movement including the effects of changing class distributions across generations, and steady‐state mobility, which captures the long‐run mobility intrinsic to the intergenerational process once the class distribution has stabilized. We further decompose overall mobility into structural and exchange components. We find that China exhibits more overall educational mobility than Russia, mostly due to greater structural mobility, while Russia exhibits greater steady‐state educational mobility. Overall and steady‐state occupational mobility are similar in China and Russia. Comparing these results to the US, we find that educational steady‐state mobility is substantially lower in China than in both Russia and the US, with Russia being the most mobile, but occupational steady‐state mobility is comparable across all three countries.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国和俄罗斯在从中央计划经济向市场体系转型过程中的代际流动性。我们将流动性视为一种运动，以父母与子女之间地位的变化来衡量。我们提供了两个关键流动性指标的估计：总体流动性，它捕捉了包括代际阶级分布变化效应在内的总代际运动；以及稳态流动性，它捕捉了阶级分布稳定后代际过程固有的长期流动性。我们进一步将总体流动性分解为结构性和交换性组成部分。我们发现，中国的总体教育流动性高于俄罗斯，这主要归因于更大的结构性流动性，而俄罗斯则表现出更高的稳态教育流动性。中国和俄罗斯的总体及稳态职业流动性相似。将这些结果与美国进行比较，我们发现中国的教育稳态流动性显著低于俄罗斯和美国，其中俄罗斯的流动性最高，但三个国家的职业稳态流动性相当。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: A Tale of Two Transitions: Mobility Dynamics in China and Russia After Central Planning
title_zh: 两种转型的故事：中央计划后中国与俄罗斯的流动性动态

abstract: Through anti‐corruption prosecutions, governments will often look to publicly signal their efforts at tackling corruption as a way of garnering political support. Our analysis combines Chinese data on the public disclosures of anti‐corruption prosecutions and individual well‐being indicators to explore the effect of these efforts for subjective well‐being. We show that while such signals are intended to garner political support, they can inadvertently lower life satisfaction among citizens, especially when political trust is low. Overall, our analysis illustrates how public demonstrations of efforts aimed at addressing issues of concern, despite their intended positive political effects, can erode public well‐being and potentially backfire when trust in the government is weak.
abstract_zh: 通过反腐败起诉，政府往往寻求公开宣示其打击腐败的努力，以此获取政治支持。我们的分析结合了中国反腐败起诉公开披露的数据与个体福祉指标，探讨这些努力对主观幸福感的影响。我们表明，尽管此类信号旨在获取政治支持，但它们可能无意中降低公民的生活满意度，尤其是在政治信任度较低的情况下。总体而言，我们的分析揭示了，针对关切问题所采取努力的公开示范，尽管预期具有积极的政治效应，但在政府信任薄弱时，可能侵蚀公众福祉并可能适得其反。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: “Tiger‐hunting” and life satisfaction: A matter of trust
title_zh: 猎虎”与生活满意度：信任的作用

abstract: CvdN equilibrium extends ratio equilibrium to local public good economies. A key and unique feature of CvdN equilibrium is that jurisdictions are fully endogenized, where the equilibrating factor is agents’ agreement on public good levels and the sharing of public good production costs. We show equilibrium existence and sorting behavior for a large class of public good economies. We furthermore elucidate how key aspects of the economy influence the nature of CvdN equilibrium, including the role of consumption preferences, jurisdictional preferences, and properties of the public good production function. These factors make possible different equilibrium jurisdiction structures, including the grand coalition, only singletons, or intermediate-sized jurisdictions, as well as jurisdictions with homogeneous or heterogeneous membership. Usefully, because it fully endogenizes jurisdiction formation, CvdN equilibrium offers a unified approach to economies with local public goods and those with global public goods, and it facilitates investigation into the underlying factors of an economy that lead to public goods being provided locally or globally. Our model can provide microfoundations for multiple concepts from the literature, including homophily, segregation, sorting, and small-group effectiveness.
abstract_zh: CvdN均衡将比例均衡扩展至地方公共品经济。CvdN均衡的一个关键且独特之处在于，辖区完全内生化，其均衡因素在于代理人对公共品水平及公共品生产成本分摊的共识。我们证明了在广泛类别的公共品经济中均衡的存在性与分群行为。此外，我们阐明了经济的关键方面如何影响CvdN均衡的性质，包括消费偏好、辖区偏好以及公共品生产函数特性的作用。这些因素使得不同的均衡辖区结构成为可能，包括大联盟、仅单个成员、或中等规模辖区，以及同质或异质成员构成的辖区。有用的是，由于完全内生化辖区形成，CvdN均衡为地方公共品经济与全球公共品经济提供了统一的分析框架，并有助于探究导致公共品在地方或全球层面供给的经济深层因素。我们的模型可为文献中的多个概念提供微观基础，包括同质性偏好、隔离、分群及小群体有效性。
title: Existence and nature of CvdN equilibrium
title_zh: CvdN均衡的存在性与性质

abstract: This study examines how strategic alliance formation influences corporate outward foreign direct investment (OFDI) decisions based on a sample of Chinese share listed companies, and finds that strategic alliances significantly promote OFDI activities by dual channels of digital transformation and R&D investment, and the promoting effect is more pronounced for firms located within the ‘Top Ten Commercial Group Cultures’ circle, those with high ESG performance, and those with lower agency costs. Analysis of market soft information shows that strategic alliances provide additional impetus for OFDI by analyst coverage and investor optimism.
abstract_zh: 本研究基于中国A股上市公司样本，探讨了战略联盟形成如何影响企业对外直接投资决策，并发现战略联盟通过数字化转型与研发投入的双重渠道显著促进了对外直接投资活动，且这一促进效应在位于“十大商业集团文化”圈内的企业、具有高ESG表现的企业以及代理成本较低的企业中更为显著。市场软信息分析显示，战略联盟通过分析师关注与投资者乐观情绪为对外直接投资提供了额外动力。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确为中国上市公司，数据基于中国股市，核心应用是中国企业对外直接投资决策。
title: Strategic alliances and outward foreign direct investment decisions
title_zh: 战略联盟与对外直接投资决策

abstract: We estimate the effects of privatization on zombie versus healthy state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in China, extending our analysis beyond TFP to a broad array of financial and economic indicators. Privatizing zombie SOEs generates persistent favorable effects: it enhances labor productivity and TFP, reduces bank subsidies, lowers leverage and administrative expenses, improves liquidity, boosts profits, and accelerates sales growth, thereby increasing their probability of recovery. Privatization’s effect on reducing government subsidies, however, is generally weaker and appears to be transient. These benefits are more pronounced than for healthy SOEs and display some heterogeneity across regions and industries. Our findings offer policy implications for emerging markets, suggesting that prioritizing the privatization of underperforming, zombie-like entities can be associated with substantial economic gains and efficiency improvements.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了私有化对中国僵尸与健康国有企业（SOEs）的影响，并将分析范围从全要素生产率（TFP）扩展至一系列广泛的金融与经济指标。私有化僵尸国有企业产生了持续积极的效果：它提升了劳动生产率与全要素生产率，减少了银行补贴，降低了杠杆率与行政开支，改善了流动性，增加了利润，并加速了销售增长，从而提高了其复苏的可能性。然而，私有化对减少政府补贴的影响普遍较弱，且似乎具有暂时性。这些益处相较于健康国有企业更为显著，并在不同地区和行业间展现出一定的异质性。我们的研究结果为新兴市场提供了政策启示，表明优先对表现不佳、类似僵尸的实体进行私有化，可带来显著的经济收益与效率提升。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Impacts of Privatization on State-Owned Enterprises: A Tale of Zombie versus Healthy Firms
title_zh: 私有化对国有企业的影响：僵尸企业与健康企业之比较

abstract: In the classical housing market problem, when all agents have strict preferences, Roth and Postlewaite (1977) show that the top trading cycles (TTC) mechanism yields the unique competitive equilibrium allocation and the unique strong core allocation. We study an extension of the housing market model that incorporates one broker. We propose the concepts of competitive equilibrium and strong core, and show that the outcome yielded by the trading cycles mechanism in Pycia and Ünver (2017) is the unique competitive equilibrium allocation and the unique strong core allocation.
abstract_zh: 在经典住房市场问题中，当所有代理具有严格偏好时，Roth和Postlewaite（1977）证明，顶级交易循环（TTC）机制产生唯一的竞争均衡配置和唯一的强核配置。我们研究了一个包含一个经纪人的住房市场模型的扩展。我们提出了竞争均衡和强核的概念，并证明Pycia和Ünver（2017）中的交易循环机制所产生的结果是唯一的竞争均衡配置和唯一的强核配置。
title: On competitive equilibria and cores in housing market problem with one broker
title_zh: 带一个中介人的住房市场问题中的竞争均衡与核

abstract: We systematically review collective agri-environmental schemes that support landscape stewardship in agriculture. We analyze 96 case studies across OECD countries based on 73 peer-reviewed articles. To guide this review, we develop a framework based on policy dimensions, the policy cycle, and micro-level implementation dimensions. This framework provides a basis for defining evaluation criteria and for assessing how these schemes are designed. The review combines the analytical power of artificial intelligence with expert domain knowledge. The synthesis of both enables a comprehensive examination of policy and implementation dimensions, resulting in critical insights into the schemes’ designs and functioning, and their broader applicability. Our results describe patterns of design and implementation in the reviewed literature, without establishing a causal link between the design and implementation of schemes and ecological outcomes. We find considerable heterogeneity among schemes indicating flexibility for decision-makers to adapt schemes to specific environmental targets at local scale, but that there is still significant room to enhance the role of farmers as key players in collective agri-environmental schemes. By integrating human expertise with the capabilities of large language models, our approach exemplifies how to balance and mitigate the limitations of each, increasing the transparency of the review process.
abstract_zh: 我们系统性地回顾了支持农业景观管理的集体农业环境计划。基于73篇同行评审文章，我们分析了OECD国家中的96个案例研究。为引导本综述，我们构建了一个基于政策维度、政策周期及微观实施维度的分析框架。该框架为定义评估标准和评估这些计划的设计方式提供了基础。本综述结合了人工智能的分析能力与专家领域知识，两者的综合运用使得对政策与实施维度进行全面审视成为可能，从而对计划的设计、运作及其更广泛的适用性提出关键见解。我们的结果描述了所回顾文献中的设计与实施模式，但并未建立计划设计与实施同生态结果之间的因果联系。我们发现各计划间存在显著异质性，表明决策者可根据地方尺度的具体环境目标灵活调整计划，但在增强农民作为集体农业环境计划关键参与者的作用方面仍有显著提升空间。通过将人类专业知识与大型语言模型的能力相结合，我们的方法展示了如何平衡并减轻各自的局限性，从而提高综述过程的透明度。
title: A review of collective agri-environmental schemes using a human–AI framework
title_zh: 基于人机协同框架的集体农业环境计划述评

abstract: This paper studies a multi-trait cultural transmission model with social interactions. The resulting cultural dynamic is equivalent to an evolutionary dynamic on a population game that combines social payoffs and cultural biases. This transformation allows us to apply tools from evolutionary game theory to examine cultural homogeneity and heterogeneity. We show that when social interactions have a coordination nature, cultural biases can push the cultural dynamic toward selecting a culturally homogeneous equilibrium that is efficient for those interactions. In contrast, when interactions have an anti-coordination nature, cultural biases usually drive the dynamic toward a culturally heterogeneous state that differs from the efficient equilibrium.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含社会互动的多特征文化传播模型。由此产生的文化动态等价于一个结合了社会收益与文化偏好的种群博弈上的演化动态。这一转换使我们能够运用演化博弈论的工具来考察文化的同质性与异质性。我们表明，当社会互动具有协调性质时，文化偏好能推动文化动态趋向于选择对这些互动而言高效的文化同质均衡。相反，当互动具有反协调性质时，文化偏好通常驱使动态走向一个不同于高效均衡的文化异质状态。
title: Intergenerational Cultural Transmission with Social Interactions as An Evolutionary Game
title_zh: 代际文化传递与社会互动的演化博弈分析

abstract: Socioemotional skills (SES) programs are widely used to promote economic empowerment, yet their returns may depend on the type of skills targeted and social context. We study this question using a randomized controlled trial (RCT) among 4500 aspiring agribusiness entrepreneurs in Nigeria within a large-scale government program. Participants were randomly assigned to an interpersonal-skills curriculum, a combined interpersonal and intrapersonal-skills curriculum of the same length, or a control group. Both trainings substantially increase women’s business performance, raising average profits by 50%. The two trainings generated broadly similar economic impacts overall. Effects are largest in communities with more liberal gender norms, where women report improvements in interpersonal skills such as empathy and negotiation, and better relational outcomes. Despite large economic gains, we find no corresponding increases in women’s empowerment or intrahousehold decision-making. For men, interpersonal-skills training increases household income, while the combined curriculum raises profits but only in the most gender-liberal environments. The results show that the returns to SES depend not only on which skills are taught, but also on whether prevailing social norms permit individuals to express and deploy those skills. Translating gains into broader empowerment may require complementary programs that relax gender norms.
abstract_zh: 社会情感技能（SES）项目被广泛用于促进经济赋权，然而其回报可能取决于所针对的技能类型及社会背景。我们通过一项随机对照试验（RCT）来研究这一问题，该试验在尼日利亚一个大规模政府项目中，对4500名有志于农业综合企业创业的个体进行了研究。参与者被随机分配至人际技能课程、同等时长的人际与内在技能综合课程，或对照组。两种培训均显著提升了女性的经营绩效，使平均利润增加了50%。总体而言，这两种培训在经济影响上大致相似。在性别规范更为自由化的社区中，效果最为显著，这些地区的女性报告称，其在同理心、谈判等人际技能方面有所提升，且关系性结果更佳。尽管经济收益显著，我们并未观察到女性赋权或家庭内部决策权的相应提升。对于男性而言，人际技能培训增加了家庭收入，而综合课程则提高了利润，但仅限于性别观念最为开放的环境中。研究结果表明，社会情感技能的回报不仅取决于所教授的技能类型，还取决于现行社会规范是否允许个体表达和运用这些技能。将收益转化为更广泛的赋权，可能需要辅以放松性别规范的补充项目。
title: Turning inward and/or outward: Which socioemotional skills pay for agribusiness entrepreneurs in Nigeria?
title_zh: 向内和/或向外转向：哪些社会情感技能对尼日利亚农业企业创业者有回报？

title: A rationale for political disengagement

abstract: Do campaign contributions polarize legislators or induce moderation? Theory allows for both possibilities, with effects likely varying by donor type. Using data on all contributions received by members of the U.S. House of Representatives from 2001 to 2022, this paper examines how Political Action Committee (PAC) and individual donations affect subsequent roll-call voting behavior. The analysis focuses on within-legislator changes in ideological positioning across congressional terms. The results consistently show that increased contributions are associated with greater moderation on the economic dimension of roll-call voting. Republican legislators shift toward the political center following increases in both PAC and individual donations in the previous congress. Democratic legislators are more ideologically stable, exhibiting relatively modest centrist movement in response to higher levels of individual contributions. Dynamic specifications suggest that these associations accumulate over successive electoral cycles, most robustly for Republican PAC receipts. Additional analysis reveals a dimensional asymmetry: the centripetal pattern is specific to economic voting, while on the social dimension higher fundraising is if anything associated with more extreme positioning among Republicans. Overall, the findings suggest that campaign contributions in the contemporary U.S. House are associated with economic moderation rather than polarization.
abstract_zh: 竞选捐款究竟是使立法者走向极化，还是促使其趋于温和？理论上两种可能性均存在，其效应可能因捐赠者类型而异。本文利用2001年至2022年间美国众议院议员收到的所有捐款数据，考察政治行动委员会（PAC）和个人捐赠对后续唱名表决行为的影响。分析聚焦于议员在国会任期之间意识形态定位的个体内部变化。结果一致表明，捐款增加与唱名表决在经济维度上的更大温和化相关。共和党议员在上一届国会中收到PAC和个人捐赠增加后，会向政治中心靠拢。民主党议员在意识形态上更为稳定，仅在个人捐赠水平较高时表现出相对适度的中间化动向。动态设定表明，这些关联在连续选举周期中累积，其中共和党PAC收入的效果最为稳健。进一步分析揭示了维度上的不对称性：向心模式仅体现在经济投票上，而在社会维度上，筹款增加若有所关联，则与共和党议员更极端的立场相关。总体而言，研究结果表明，当代美国众议院中的竞选捐款与经济温和化相关，而非极化。
title: Money talks, moderation walks: the centripetal impact of campaign contributions in the U.S. house
title_zh: 金钱说话，温和走开：竞选捐款对美国众议院的向心影响

abstract: We study how large-load customers affect household electricity prices. We map the AI-associated data center build-out in the years following 2021 to U.S. utility territories and implement a shift-share design based on pre-AI fiber infrastructure. A standard deviation of ten data centers raises household electricity prices by 13%, and a single hyperscaler facility increases prices by 4%. Demand-driven channels seem to be the dominant mechanism, and households bear a disproportionate burden compared to other customers. Nonprofit utilities, energy surplus, and retail competition may mitigate price impacts. Our results provide novel insights about electricity price spillovers from large individual consumers.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了大型负荷客户如何影响居民电价。我们将2021年后与人工智能相关的数据中心建设布局映射至美国公用事业区域，并基于人工智能前光纤基础设施实施了一种份额转移设计。每增加一个标准差的数据中心数量，居民电价上升13%，而单个超大规模设施则使电价提高4%。需求驱动渠道似乎是主导机制，且与其他客户相比，居民承担了不成比例的负担。非营利性公用事业、能源盈余及零售竞争可能缓解价格影响。我们的研究结果为大型个体消费者带来的电价溢出效应提供了新颖见解。
title: Large-Load Electricity Customers and Spillovers on Household Prices: Evidence from U.S. Data Centers
title_zh: 大型电力用户与家庭电价溢出效应：来自美国数据中心的证据

abstract: This paper examines the underexplored role of China’s policy bank loans as a countercyclical tool for stabilizing economic fluctuations, complementing conventional fiscal and monetary policies. Utilizing panel data on Chinese listed companies from 2005 to 2023, we demonstrate that policy bank loans effectively mitigate the adverse impacts of economic downturns, and ensure corporate value stability during periods of contraction. The research further identifies that the countercyclical effect of these loans is influenced by both internal factors, including political and economic stability and tax revenue growth, as well as external factors such as global financial uncertainty. Additionally, the study highlights the complementary role of policy bank loans alongside conventional stabilization measures, strengthening the combined capacity to enhance macroeconomic stability. KEYWORDS: Policy banks countercyclical listed firms economic stability JEL CLASSIFICATION: G21 G32
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国政策性银行贷款作为稳定经济波动的逆周期工具这一尚未充分研究的角色，其与常规财政和货币政策形成互补。利用2005年至2023年中国上市公司的面板数据，我们证明政策性银行贷款能够有效缓解经济下行带来的不利影响，并在经济收缩期间保障企业价值稳定。研究进一步识别出，这些贷款的逆周期效应受到内部因素（包括政治与经济稳定性及税收增长）和外部因素（如全球金融不确定性）的共同影响。此外，研究强调了政策性银行贷款与常规稳定措施之间的互补作用，增强了共同提升宏观经济稳定的能力。关键词：政策性银行 逆周期 上市公司 经济稳定 JEL分类：G21 G32

title: Slavery, freedom, and development By Warren C.Whatley, (Cambridge University Press, 2026). Pp. 237. Hbk £35. ISBN 9781009407144.

abstract: Recent historical national accounting data show that the timing of the Great Divergence hinges on the different trends in north‐west Europe and the Yangzi Delta region of China. Although north‐west Europe only pulled ahead of the Yangzi Delta after 1700, both the positive trend of GDP per capita in north‐west Europe after 1700 and the negative trend in the Yangzi Delta were continuations of a process that began in the fourteenth century, driven by different paths of innovation. We provide an analytic narrative of the Great Divergence based on the proximate sources of growth and the fundamental sources of innovation.
abstract_zh: 近期历史国民经济核算数据显示，大分流的时机取决于西北欧与中国长江三角洲地区不同的发展趋势。尽管西北欧仅在1700年后才超越长江三角洲，但西北欧人均GDP在1700年后的正向趋势与长江三角洲的负向趋势，都是始于14世纪进程的延续，这一进程由不同的创新路径所驱动。我们基于增长的直接来源与创新的根本来源，对大分流进行了分析性叙述。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象明确包含中国长江三角洲地区，并以其与西北欧的对比分析大分流，属于中国地区研究。
title: Innovation and the great divergence
title_zh: 创新与大分流

abstract: We examine whether law school alumni relationships between lawyers and judges are correlated with case outcomes. We show that, in the context of medical malpractice lawsuits filed in Florida, having a plaintiff's attorney who attended the same law school as a randomly assigned judge increases the chances of recovery by about 2 percentage points. We further show that the effect is more pronounced between lawyers and judges with a larger age gap, consistent with an age‐dependent effect. Our results suggest that case outcomes can be biased when lawyers and judges are part of the same affinity group.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了律师与法官之间的法学院校友关系是否与案件结果相关。我们表明，在佛罗里达州提起的医疗事故诉讼背景下，原告律师与随机分配的法官毕业于同一所法学院，会使获得赔偿的可能性增加约2个百分点。我们进一步显示，这种效应在年龄差距较大的律师与法官之间更为显著，这与年龄依赖效应相符。我们的结果表明，当律师和法官属于同一亲和群体时，案件结果可能产生偏差。
title: Alumni relationships and judicial bias
title_zh: 校友关系与司法偏见

abstract: Existing evidence shows consumers are willing to pay for labeled environmental attributes. However, there is a gap regarding whether consumers have a willingness to engage (WTE) with detailed information. The European Union’s circular economy action plan provides for a new Digital Product Passport (DPP), holding information including embedded emissions, components and materials, chemical substances, and instructions for repair, disassembly and sustainable disposal. In our theory, a green consumer decides how much to engage with information that helps them mitigate their environmental damage from consumption, given a cognitive or time cost. We test the model using a lab experiment where environmental attributes of a good are only available through a DPP. We find education on the DPP’s purpose is key to increasing revealed WTE with a DPP. This is driven by those with a lower stated WTE; participants with a high stated WTE interact with the DPP regardless. Engagement with the DPP increases knowledge and willingness to pay (WTP), as the DPP reveals favorable environmental information. We find no evidence of positive spillovers from the DPP (no further shifts in environmental orientation or increased subsequent behavior), but we find evidence that increases in WTP due to the DPP, and exposure to the DPP, lead to a negative spillover in a subsequent behavior (environmental donation). We further contribute novel measures of stated and revealed WTE, and demonstrate their value in understanding consumer behavior in a theoretically informed manner. Our study provides insights for field testing and rollout of a DPP or similar.
abstract_zh: 现有证据表明，消费者愿意为标注的环境属性支付费用。然而，关于消费者是否愿意参与（WTE）详细信息方面仍存在研究空白。欧盟循环经济行动计划规定了新的数字产品护照（DPP），其中包含嵌入排放、组件与材料、化学物质以及维修、拆解和可持续处置说明等信息。在我们的理论中，绿色消费者在面临认知或时间成本的情况下，决定投入多少精力去接触有助于减轻其消费对环境损害的信息。我们通过实验室实验检验该模型，实验中商品的环境属性仅能通过DPP获取。我们发现，对DPP目的的教育是提高揭示性WTE的关键因素，这一效应主要由那些声明WTE较低的参与者驱动；而声明WTE较高的参与者无论是否接受教育都会与DPP互动。与DPP的互动增加了知识水平和支付意愿（WTP），因为DPP揭示了有利的环境信息。我们未发现DPP存在正向溢出效应的证据（环境取向无进一步转变或后续行为无增加），但发现DPP导致的WTP增加以及接触DPP，会在后续行为（环境捐赠）中产生负向溢出效应。我们进一步贡献了声明性和揭示性WTE的新颖测量方法，并展示了其在理论指导下理解消费者行为方面的价值。我们的研究为DPP或类似机制的实地测试和推广提供了见解。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: From Willingness to Engage to Demand: A Behavioral Experiment on Green Consumer Information in a Digital Product Passport
title_zh: 从参与意愿到需求：数字产品护照中绿色消费者信息的行为实验

abstract: Ensuring food security under binding land constraints is a central challenge for many developing economies. Using a county-level panel dataset for China from 2000 to 2022, this study examines how agricultural technological innovation affects grain yield under land scarcity. We construct quality-adjusted patent stocks of grain-related technologies based on patent microdata and distinguish between input-oriented innovation and field-management innovation. By integrating patent data, business registration records, and official agricultural statistics, we empirically examine the effects of agricultural technological innovation on grain yield. The results show that agricultural technological innovation significantly increases grain yield: a doubling of the quality-adjusted stock of grain-related patents is associated with an approximately 1.10% increase in grain yield. However, its effects differ sharply by innovation type. Input-oriented innovation exhibits limited or even negative effects, whereas field-management innovation consistently enhances grain yield. Heterogeneity analyses show stronger yield effects in major grain-producing regions, areas with broader technological coverage and greater patent collaboration, and lower-yield counties. Mechanism analyses indicate that production organization and agricultural socialized services are key channels through which innovation translates into yield gains. Overall, the findings suggest that productivity gains in land-scarce agricultural systems depend less on input intensification than on effective production management and supportive institutional arrangements, with broader implications for other land-constrained developing economies.
abstract_zh: 在土地约束下保障粮食安全是许多发展中经济体面临的核心挑战。利用2000年至2022年中国县级面板数据，本研究考察了农业技术创新在土地稀缺条件下如何影响粮食产量。我们基于专利微观数据构建了粮食相关技术的质量调整专利存量，并区分了投入导向型创新与田间管理型创新。通过整合专利数据、企业注册记录和官方农业统计数据，我们实证检验了农业技术创新对粮食产量的影响。结果表明，农业技术创新显著提高了粮食产量：质量调整后的粮食相关专利存量翻一番，与粮食产量约1.10%的增长相关联。然而，其效应因创新类型不同而存在显著差异。投入导向型创新的效应有限甚至为负，而田间管理型创新则持续提升粮食产量。异质性分析显示，在粮食主产区、技术覆盖范围更广且专利合作更多的地区以及低产县，产量效应更为显著。机制分析表明，生产组织方式和农业社会化服务是创新转化为产量增长的关键渠道。总体而言，研究结果表明，在土地稀缺的农业系统中，生产率的提升更多依赖于有效的生产管理和支持性制度安排，而非投入集约化，这对其他土地受限的发展中经济体具有更广泛的启示意义。

title: Feeding a fifth of the world under land constraints: Agricultural innovation and grain yield growth in China
title_zh: 土地约束下养活全球五分之一人口：中国的农业创新与粮食单产增长

abstract: This paper studies the distortionary effects of land-use regulations that preserve farmland from urban sprawl. I exploit a major policy restricting farm-to-urban land conversion in China — the Farmland Red Line Policy — to provide causal evidence on the negative impact of land-use regulation on local development, measured by GDP and population growth. To understand the aggregate impact of the policy, I develop a quantitative spatial equilibrium model that features endogenous land-use decisions. The calibrated model reveals a 7% loss in workers’ welfare due to the policy. Furthermore, a cap-and-trade platform that allows local regions to exchange farmland preservation requirements can eliminate 60% of workers’ welfare costs. The results highlight the substantial welfare costs that can arise from suboptimal land-use policies, underscoring the need for careful design in fast-growing economies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了旨在保护农田免受城市扩张影响的土地使用法规所产生的扭曲效应。我利用中国一项限制农地转用的重大政策——农田红线政策——作为自然实验，提供了土地使用法规对地方发展（以GDP和人口增长衡量）产生负面影响的因果证据。为理解该政策的总体影响，我构建了一个包含内生土地使用决策的定量空间均衡模型。校准模型显示，该政策导致工人福利损失7%。此外，一个允许各地区交易农田保护义务的总量控制与交易平台，能够消除60%的工人福利成本。研究结果凸显了次优土地使用政策可能带来的巨大福利代价，强调了在快速增长经济体中政策设计需谨慎的重要性。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The local and aggregate effects of land-use regulation on farmland protection
title_zh: 土地利用规制对农田保护的局部与总体效应

abstract: Cities have become fewer, bigger, and flatter in many countries. Better transport access has fostered the concentration of economic activities toward fewer, bigger cities, while each city has become more decentralized. We show that two types of dispersion forces against spatial agglomeration explain the dual evolution of cities. Dispersion forces within a city, such as those arising from the consumption of limited land, affect only the city's residents. A decrease in transport costs reduces the relative benefits of agglomeration in a congested central location, making the population distribution in each city flatter and more spread out to achieve a balance between the costs and benefits of agglomeration. Dispersion forces that spill over beyond a city, such as market crowding, make locations near the city unattractive. Lower transport costs promote competition for a wider area around each city, leaving fewer cities with larger distances between them. A model's comparative static results, and thus its policy implications, depend on the type of dispersion forces it incorporates.
abstract_zh: 运输成本如何影响经济活动的空间组织？本研究构建了一个理论框架，区分了空间模型中的两类分散力：“本地”分散力作用于城市内部，而“全球”分散力则作用于城市之间。这一区分使得空间模型得以系统性地归类为几种基本类型，每种类型具有不同的内生空间格局及对运输成本变化的比较静态响应。该框架调和了实证发现，并阐明了运输引发的经济活动重组如何取决于主导分散力的空间尺度。
title: Spatial scale of agglomeration and dispersion: Number, spacing, and the spatial extent of cities
title_zh: 集聚与分散的空间尺度：城市数量、间距及空间范围

abstract: How does partisan conflict (PC) relate to economic policy uncertainty (EPU)? When does uncertainty feed back into conflict, and how stable is that link? We examine these dynamics using a time-varying Granger causality framework applied to United States monthly data from 1985 to 2025, combining the PC Index with aggregate and disaggregated EPU subindices. PC consistently precedes spikes in fiscal, tax, spending, and health care uncertainty. In contrast, the predictive direction reverses mainly during large shocks, such as trade conflicts or financial regulation crises, and largely disappears during recessions. Generalised forecast error variance decompositions show that PC shocks account for a modest but non trivial share of forecast error variance in fiscal, tax, spending, and health care uncertainty, while policy shocks in trade and regulatory domains explain a much larger share of the variance in partisan conflict itself. These results reveal asymmetric, time-varying predictive linkages between political polarization and policy uncertainty. The findings, which are based on the decomposition of EPU into its components and time-varying Granger causality, contribute to theories of veto players, gridlock, and signaling by identifying the institutional conditions under which political conflict is associated with greater economic volatility and when policy uncertainty appears to reinforce partisan division.
abstract_zh: 党派冲突（PC）与经济政策不确定性（EPU）之间存在何种关联？不确定性何时会反馈至冲突之中，且这一联系的稳定性如何？我们运用时变格兰杰因果框架，结合美国1985年至2025年的月度数据，将PC指数与总体及分项EPU子指数相结合，对上述动态进行了考察。PC始终先于财政、税收、支出及医疗保健领域不确定性的飙升。相反，预测方向主要在大规模冲击期间发生逆转，如贸易冲突或金融监管危机，并在经济衰退期间基本消失。广义预测误差方差分解显示，PC冲击对财政、税收、支出及医疗保健不确定性预测误差方差的贡献虽适度但不可忽视，而贸易和监管领域的政策冲击则解释了党派冲突自身预测误差方差的更大份额。这些结果揭示了政治极化与政策不确定性之间非对称、时变的预测关联。基于EPU分项分解及时变格兰杰因果的发现，通过识别政治冲突与经济波动加剧相关联的制度条件，以及政策不确定性似乎强化党派分歧的情境，为否决者、僵局及信号传递理论作出了贡献。
title: Partisan conflict and economic policy uncertainty: insights from a time-varying causality approach
title_zh: 党派冲突与经济政策不确定性：基于时变因果方法的洞察

abstract: Governments support nonprofits through direct grants and tax incentives for private donations, but the optimal mix of these tools remains unclear. I develop a model in which households donate to multiple causes and the government can use both instruments to support nonprofit funding. A key determinant of the optimal policy mix is tax discrimination, defined as the ability to vary tax incentives by cause. When tax discrimination is feasible, warm-glow giving makes private funding more efficient, reducing the need for grants. However, when tax discrimination is constrained, grants become essential to compensate for the rigidity of the tax system. In a calibrated example, the optimal government share of nonprofit funding rises from 0% to 60% as tax discrimination becomes more limited. When donations are leaky, delivering less than a dollar of value per dollar given, the importance of tax discrimination declines. In the extreme case of uniform leakage, Pareto efficiency can be achieved with grants and a linear tax credit, uniform across causes, similar to the systems currently implemented in Belgium, France, or New Zealand.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了向非营利组织提供直接公共资金的政府拨款与降低慈善捐赠成本的税收激励之间的最优组合。当非营利组织在吸引捐赠者方面面临高昂的筹款成本时，税收激励无法完全替代拨款，拨款仍是最优资助政策的一部分。当筹款成本足够低时，能够针对不同事业定制税收激励的政府，可以完全通过捐赠来资助某些事业。然而，当无法按事业差异化税收待遇时，拨款仍是必要的，以适应各事业间资金需求的差异。在一个校准示例中，对各类慈善事业的捐赠实施统一税收待遇，会将拨款覆盖的非营利组织资金最优份额从0%提升至60%。
title: How to fund nonprofits?
title_zh: 如何为非营利组织提供资金？

abstract: Can digital technologies improve the efficiency of social safety net programs? This paper examines the impact of digitizing payments in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) on participant outcomes. We hand-collect the rollout schedule of payment digitization and link it to WIC participation and birth outcomes across multiple datasets. We find that WIC participation increases and birth outcomes improve among mothers exposed to digitization. Suggestive evidence indicates that payment digitization raises WIC participation by increasing awareness of the program and reducing stigma at the point of purchase, and that higher participation may, in turn, improve birth outcomes by increasing health insurance enrollment. Our back-of-the-envelope calculations suggest that payment digitization is fiscally appealing, with a marginal value of public funds of 0.94. These findings can inform evaluations of further digitization in safety net programs, such as online redemption.
abstract_zh: 数字技术能否提升社会安全网项目的效率？本文考察了妇女、婴儿及儿童特别补充营养计划（WIC）中支付数字化的影响及其对参与者结果的作用。我们手工收集了支付数字化的推广时间表，并将其与多个数据集中的WIC参与情况及出生结果相关联。研究发现，接触数字化的母亲中，WIC参与率上升，出生结果得到改善。初步证据表明，支付数字化通过提高项目认知度和减少购买时的污名效应来增加WIC参与，而更高的参与率可能进而通过增加健康保险注册来改善出生结果。我们的粗略估算显示，支付数字化在财政上具有吸引力，公共资金的边际价值为0.94。这些发现可为评估安全网项目中进一步数字化（如在线兑换）提供参考。
title: Safety net payment digitization and participant outcomes: Evidence from the WIC EBT transition
title_zh: 安全网支付数字化与参与者结果：来自WIC EBT转型的证据

abstract: According to the forward guidance puzzle, the economy responds more strongly to future than current interest rate cuts in many policy models used by central banks. We show that the puzzle arises only if three conditions are met: (1) a future interest rate cut is announced, (2) an interest rate peg precedes it, and (3) agents are assumed to attribute the peg exclusively to a sequence of monetary policy shocks. Absent any of these conditions, the response to a promised future interest rate cut weakens with the anticipation horizon, and forward guidance is no longer a forceful policy.
abstract_zh: 根据前瞻指引之谜，在许多央行使用的政策模型中，经济对未来利率下调的反应强于对当前利率下调的反应。我们表明，这一谜题仅在满足三个条件时才会出现：（1）宣布未来利率下调，（2）在此之前存在利率钉住，（3）假设代理人将钉住完全归因于一系列货币政策冲击。若缺少任一条件，对承诺的未来利率下调的反应会随预期期限延长而减弱，前瞻指引不再是一项强有力的政策。
title: There is no Forward Guidance Puzzle
title_zh: 不存在前瞻指引之谜

abstract: A majority of small U.S. businesses attempting to reorganize in bankruptcy fail to do so. Subchapter V of Chapter 11 (SubV) streamlines bankruptcy for small firms by reducing bankruptcy costs and negotiation frictions, and enables entrepreneurs to retain ownership. We show that many businesses reorganize under SubV that otherwise would liquidate. Creditor recoveries and postbankruptcy survival rates are at least as high in SubV as in traditional Chapter 11s. Our results show the increase in reorganizations is not associated with continuation of unviable firms, and that creditors are not harmed by a shift in bargaining power toward small business owners.
abstract_zh: 美国大多数试图通过破产重组的小型企业未能成功。第11章第V分章（SubV）通过降低破产成本和谈判摩擦，为小企业简化了破产程序，并使企业家能够保留所有权。我们表明，许多原本会清算的企业在SubV下得以重组。债权人的回收率和破产后生存率在SubV中至少与传统第11章一样高。我们的结果显示，重组增加与不可持续企业的延续无关，且债权人并未因谈判权力向小企业主转移而受损。
title: Can Small Businesses Survive Chapter 11?
title_zh: 小企业能否在第十一章破产保护中生存？

abstract: We propose a new method to estimate the marginal value of capital under minimal assumptions. By combining asset prices with fundamentals, our method provides a quasi‐model‐free marginal q together with a simple correction for measurement error in (average) Tobin's Q using linear regressions. Marginal q yields plausible and robust estimates of adjustment costs and investment sensitivities to fundamentals. The widening gap between marginal q and Tobin's Q is driven primarily by market power and intangible capital. Our novel findings strongly support the neoclassical theory of investment and challenge the widespread use of Tobin's Q as proxy for investment opportunities.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在最小假设下估计资本边际价值的新方法。通过将资产价格与基本面相结合，我们的方法提供了一种准模型无关的边际q，并利用线性回归对（平均）托宾Q中的测量误差进行了简单修正。边际q得出了关于调整成本和投资对基本面敏感性的合理且稳健的估计。边际q与托宾Q之间日益扩大的差距主要由市场势力和无形资本驱动。我们的新发现有力地支持了新古典投资理论，并对广泛使用托宾Q作为投资机会代理变量的做法提出了挑战。
title: Marginal Q
title_zh: 边际Q

abstract: Aggregate productivity growth in Europe has disappointed over the last two decades, fuelling concerns about competitiveness. This column argues that firm-level evidence points to a more optimistic picture. Productivity differences between firms have stopped widening, and initially low-productivity firms have started moving up the productivity ladder. To speed up productivity convergence within industries, policies should reduce regulatory and administrative barriers to entry and expansion, strengthen competition enforcement, and deepen the Single Market. Investing in a European harmonised framework for firm-level data is also key for understanding productivity developments and devising economic policy.
abstract_zh: 过去二十年，欧洲总体生产率增长令人失望，引发了对竞争力的担忧。本文认为，企业层面的证据指向了一个更为乐观的景象。企业间的生产率差距已停止扩大，起初生产率较低的企业开始向生产率阶梯的上方移动。为了加速行业内生产率的趋同，政策应减少进入和扩张的监管及行政障碍，加强竞争执法，并深化单一市场。投资于欧洲统一的企业层面数据框架，对于理解生产率动态和制定经济政策也至关重要。
authors: Filippo Di Mauro, Ashim Dubey, Chad Syverson, Alessandro Zona Mattioli
title: Europe’s productivity is more dynamic than aggregate statistics suggest
title_zh: 欧洲生产率比总体统计数据显示的更具活力

abstract: Official Russian statistics report a mild recession in 2022 following the full-scale of Ukraine but suggest that Russia has since fully recovered. This column argues that data on nighttime lights emitted by Russian cities suggest otherwise. The authors find evidence of a significant economic slowdown due to the war, and substantial redistribution of economic activity across Russia’s regions. The costs appear to have been concentrated where it matters: in the economic and political core of Russia.
abstract_zh: 俄罗斯官方统计数据显示，2022年乌克兰全面冲突后俄罗斯经历了一场轻度衰退，但表明此后经济已完全复苏。本文认为，俄罗斯城市夜间灯光数据所反映的情况并非如此。作者发现，战争导致了显著的经济放缓，并且俄罗斯各地区的经济活动发生了大规模重新分配。这些代价似乎集中在关键之处：俄罗斯的经济与政治核心区域。
authors: Irakli Barbakadze, Jan Fidrmuc, Martin Hulényi, Ketevani Kapanadze
title: When statistics lie: Using satellite data to track Russia’s wartime economy
title_zh: 当统计数据失真：利用卫星数据追踪俄罗斯战时经济
